text_block_list.text:
For some reason,
when I pushed the button for coffee, 
a sweet-looking drink came out of the vending
machine.

Because of work,
I was eating lunch later than usual. 
But luckily,
I was still able to get the usual.

It had been a while since that really rainy
day. The only thing I 
could think of was trying to figure out what
『Marvelous』 meant――

At night, when I was brushing my teeth,
I would wonder if 
this was marvelous. In the morning,
when deciding which sock to put on first,
I'd wonder if this was marvelous.

Normally,
you'd think I should be focusing on 
scouting an Uma Musume, but instead,
I was 
desperately searching for the meaning of
marvelous.

At this rate,
my everday life would be destroyed 
by marvelous.
Or was it already too late? I mean, 
it seemed like I could hear it right now――
Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaa☆ Were you surprised?
Were you surprised?

It wasn't that I was surprised.
I was worried that I 
was so far gone that I was marvelously
hearing things!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh little lost lamb, how do you do☆? 
Can't find Marvelous? I'll just show you★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous, you see, is sparkly, exciting,
derring-do☆ 
It's always there all around,
just waiting for someone like you★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So c'mon, let's go☆ 
Allllll~ that's Marvelous, Trainer,
it's time for a show!

Declaring that,
Marvelous Sunday grabbed my arm and
pulled 
me along.
Her hands seemed particularly warm.

I couldn't say no to that,
because I wanted 
to know the truth about 『Marvelous』, but――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nature~! Laurel~! Ahahahaa, Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you're late……wait,
huh? Aren't you that trainer from 
before? Ahaha, she caught you, huh? Good work~,
I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, guess I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Nice Nature. Marvelous 
is my roommate,
guess you could call it an inevitable
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Laurel♪ Marve-chan's…… Hmmm~,
I guess 
you could say friendly rival,
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaa, inevitable rivals! Sounds fun~! 
It's like fate, so very Marvelous☆,
isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, Trainer,
Nature and Laurel are really Marvelous! 
When they run, it's like zooooom, whooosh,
and zip!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When they're on their own they're Marvelous,
but when they're together, 
they're even more Marvelous!
I'm sure Trainer can tell too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait wait, even if you say that,
they can't tell with that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait…… something feels off here. 
Aren't you a bit more lively than usual?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to parallel training
but…… Hmmmmm~? Marve-chan, 
are you hiding something from us?
Like you're feeling off or――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not a bit~! Today, I'm very Marvelous☆ too,
you know. If I can run 
with Laurel and Nature,
it'll be mooore~ Marvelous★
choice_data_list: But, your hands were really warm……?

text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned that to Sakura Laurel and
Nice Nature, 
it seemed like their expressions clouded a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is,
huh. ――In that case, Marve-chan, we'll 
hold off on today's training!
Let's head to the infirmary, okay?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeh, why!? 
What about Marvelous?
What about training~!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez,
I'm glad we realized it was a slight
fever. 
If she did training like that,
it would definitely get worse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san too,
thanks for coming with us. 
Marve-chan's always pushing herself like
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm~…… usually it doesn't get as bad as
a fever. The current 
Marve-chan doesn't have a particularly weak
constitution.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's just,
when she was little she was often sick,
so maybe that's related. She's so lively 
that she moves around alot so that could be
it too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I don't understand how nice
it is to be able to run around, 
but, it does worry me that she doesn't seem
to know her limits……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But well,
there's a Selection race soon after all.
I guess we'll 
just hope she can find a trainer that's good
at managing that.

That was unexpected.
From what I had seen so far of Marvelous
Sunday, 
she was always cheerful and powerful.
But if I think back on it――

The day I met her,
she had suddenly collapsed 
due to exhaustion on the course.
Seemed like it was true,
that she was bad at putting on the brakes.

I was captivated by her cheerful laugh while
running, maybe that 
was why I was so interested in the meaning
of 『Marvelous』.

However,
for her 『Marvelous』 seemed to have some kind
of 
meaning that made her pursue it to the
detriment of her health.

I was confused by the large gap between
her energetic appearance whenever she said
『Marvelous!』 
and her current state of laying passed out
in bed.

She said she'd show me what marvelous
meant. 
When she's better,
I'll ask her directly what it means.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (……Ah, again……it's that dream……)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (It's cold……and dark……)

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Mama…… Papa……?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Around this time I……didn't have the 
strength to find what was marvelous……)

text_block_list.name: Young Marvelous
text_block_list.text: ……Grandm-……
